ev.q: This population-based study presents PCE prevalence among U.S. adults in four states.
Weighted prevalence estimates and 95% CIs were calculated for individual PCEs and cumulative PCE scores
Weighted family and community subscore means and 95% CIs were compared using t-tests.
Nonoverlapping CIs were used to assess statistically significant prevalence differences between sociodemographic categories.
Finally, cross-sectional data cannot demonstrate causality.

methods_quotes.q: Nonoverlapping CIs were used to assess statistically significant prevalence differences between sociodemographic categories.
Weighted family and community subscore means and 95% CIs were compared using t-tests.
